modificationDescription: Ultimate-owned, scoped-down reimplementation of PrimeReact's ComponentBase. Verified source: cx() resolves css.classes[key](params) (ComponentBase.js lines ~511-513). Ultimate decision: excludes the full pt/ptm/ptmo passthrough system (~150 lines of nested-key resolution in the verified source) entirely, per spec §7's Option B posture — no demonstrated Ultimate consumer need, same YAGNI justification as Angular's ADR-018.
Ultimate-authored test, not derived from upstream (PrimeReact's own ComponentBase.js has no dedicated spec file).
Ultimate-authored barrel re-export, no upstream equivalent.
Ultimate-authored root barrel re-exporting all react-core submodules, no upstream equivalent file.

Verified upstream behavior: runs an effect exactly once on mount via useEffect with an empty dependency array. Authored fresh in TypeScript, not ported line-for-line — trivial enough that the verified behavior fully specifies the implementation.
Verified upstream behavior: runs a cleanup function once on unmount via useEffect returning that cleanup, empty dependency array.
Verified upstream behavior: skips the effect on the first (mount) run, fires on subsequent dependency changes, via a mounted-ref guard.
Verified upstream behavior: returns undefined on first render, the previous value thereafter, via a ref updated in a post-render effect.

Verified upstream behavior (useMergeProps.js): shallow-merges class names (concatenated) and event handlers (composed, not overwritten) across prop sets, later objects winning for all other keys. Authored fresh, not ported line-for-line.
Verified upstream behavior: bind/unbind pair attaching/detaching a listener on a resolved target (supports 'window'/'document' string targets and function-resolved targets), gated by a `when` flag.

Verified upstream behavior: a window-resize-specific specialization of the event-listener bind/unbind pattern. Implemented here as a thin wrapper over useEventListener rather than a duplicate implementation.
Ultimate-authored test suite covering all seven hooks, not derived from upstream (PrimeReact's own hooks have no dedicated per-hook spec files in this version).
Ultimate-authored barrel re-export, no upstream equivalent.
